en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3132 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"The first act of justice that the Qa'im (as) will manifest is that his caller will announce: 'Those performing supererogatory acts (nafilah) must yield the Black Stone and the Tawaf around the Kaaba to those performing obligatory acts (faridah).'"
